payload.name: Validate Pending Keywords by Reading When Settlement Is Paused
payload.description: When the keyword settlement loop is paused, pending terms are judged by reading each container's own name, topics and body. Yes needs support, no needs a reason, doubt leaves the term alone, and no term with real use is removed.

principles.name: Asymmetric judgment
principles.description: Keeping a doubtful term costs little; removing a good one hides content from search.

principles.name: Record who decided
principles.description: A hand decision is not the strength-N gate and is recorded as such.

heuristics.condition: a batch creates containers while settlement is paused and strict search is on
heuristics.action: validate their new terms right after the batch, because strict search ignores pending terms

heuristics.condition: a term has kept, applied or packed hits
heuristics.action: do not remove it; restore it as pending if an audit finds it removed

decision_rules.name: Judge by reading
decision_rules.condition: pending non-marker terms exist on a container
decision_rules.outcome: read the container's name, topics and real body; mark a term validated only when they support it, remove it only with a stated reason, and leave it untouched when in doubt

decision_rules.name: Hit guard
decision_rules.condition: a term is about to be removed
decision_rules.outcome: check its stored hits first; any kept, applied, packed or human hit blocks the removal

decision_rules.name: Know the wrong shapes
decision_rules.outcome: remove wrong-sense expansions, terms in another language than the content, templated recombinations of one distinct concept, identifiers and numbers, malformed tokens with punctuation, and generic fragments

decision_rules.name: Record the decision
decision_rules.condition: a term is decided by hand
decision_rules.outcome: write a ledger row with the support flag and the reason; the ledger, not the term record, says it was reviewed by hand

decision_rules.name: Before, after, pilot
decision_rules.outcome: save each container's before-state, re-read the after-state, check health between batches, and pilot first

decision_rules.name: Measure strict before flipping
decision_rules.outcome: replay the logged queries both ways first and check that types which can never be validated, such as rule sets, roots and ingest rows, are exempt
